scope: All rows of the pinned community N2 vocabulary CSV; not an official JLPT syllabus.

planning.candidateLimits: Navigation only; neither candidates nor their absence establish verified coverage or final new/reused article counts.

indexSemantics.source_id: N2:physical CSV line number, including the header at line 1.
indexSemantics.source_kanji: Original CSV kanji field, including empty values; source form is this or source_reading.
indexSemantics.source_gloss: Original Waller gloss, retained as evidence rather than endorsed verbatim teaching text.
indexSemantics.source_jmdict_entry: Original supplied identity; never overwritten by a teaching correction.
indexSemantics.batch: Planned sequential 20-row batch; not an authoring or review-closure assertion.
indexSemantics.status: pending, draft, closed, or unresolved, as defined in n2-vocabulary-review.md.
indexSemantics.article: Stable repository-relative article actually teaching this row's spelling/reading/use; blank while pending.
indexSemantics.article_level: Actual easiest sourced article-level label; does not replace source_level.
indexSemantics.jmdict_entry: Selected inspected teaching identity, potentially different from the original supplied ID.
indexSemantics.sense_indices: Non-exhaustive one-based teaching senses in the recorded snapshot, respecting spelling and reading restrictions.
indexSemantics.additional_senses: Separately distinguished entry:sense pairs; not extra source rows or automatic N2 assignments.
indexSemantics.mapping_note: Spelling normalization, explicit alias coverage, or preservation of the original spelling.
indexSemantics.identity_note: Evidence-backed correction or qualification of a supplied lexical identity.
indexSemantics.source_note: Qualified source gloss, spelling/sense distinction, or retained uncertainty; not additional level evidence.
